GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, enjoyed run of the race to 1.5 Lengths rail turning, Held Up home turn and blocked early in straight, shouldered into gap at the 200m, hit Lead 140m, went clear and kept going to post # solid win

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths 3 Wide turning, improved into the race rounding turn, 4-5 Wide at 350m, centre of track Straightening Up , kept coming in straight, probably tired a bit final 75m or so. # wide, tough run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted wider with cover rounding turn, peeled off an Five Wide Straightening Up , Made Some Ground in straight. (Bandages (Front) FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages. Post-race vet exam revealed the thumps.] # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly throughout the middle stages of the event. Laid in under pressure in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the thumps.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, enjoyed comfortable run with the sit middle stages, traiuled 3 Lengths rail turning, railed up rounding turn, taken Two Wide around heels Straightening Up , Moved Up and joined Lead 100m looking likely o go straight past but had to battled hard right to the line. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME) # won in headbobber
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Got its head up passing the 1500m when close to heels. Contacted near the 50m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Settled Down rear Inside 8 Lengths within 7 Lengths x 800m 6 Lengths x 600m Ridden Along Turning for home , 6th x 200m 5th x 50m, 1st sat 2nd Sound - # not run to suit
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Laid in under pressure over the concluding stages.
Slow to begin. Wide for the majority.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down last 12 Lengths from the lead, little change to to 11 Lengths rail appraoching turn, Hooked Out Wide With Cover rounding turn, shifted around heels and widest at 300m, built up momentum while improving then rocketed home from the 150m # back/strong finish
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Over the final 100m laid in under pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Tightened 1 length at the start and Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, Held Up 500m-300m, off fence at 300m and Made Ground through field in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages.] # Had excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Tightened at the start between runners. Raced keenly in the middle stages, and passing the 700m steadied from heels. Held up for clear running from the 500m until the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out & got back to 15 Lengths on fence settling down, Moved Up to 7.5 Lengths rail turning, Held Up 500m-400m then shifted Two Wide before fanning across heels and widest Straightening Up , ran on well down the outside arriving too late # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. When the pace eased near the 1400m was steadied and then raced with its head up for a short distance. Held up for clear running from the 500m until approaching the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down last 10 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 7.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Ground down the outside in Straight # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. When under pressure in the home straight, laid in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Settled Down fourth last rail 9-10 Lengths (1200m), going ok awkward spot 500, off rail Turn & widest runner 300, made late Ground # got moving late
